answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 14 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 556 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. What carries the jetty here is verification, the timber of cost is what stops the farm, and the sparrow of the record keeps every claim checkable.
